title: Your local connections can build something bigger.
summary: An open local market begins with the people and businesses who already care about a place.
body:
Every community has people who know where to find a good meal, who makes something special, and which neighbor always has a useful recommendation. That local knowledge is valuable.

Hey99 brings it together with the businesses of Manteca, Lathrop, Ripon, Salida and Escalon. Merchants bring their offers. Neighbors bring connections, stories and discoveries. Together, they help useful things find the people who need them.

We call this coselling: helping commerce happen through connections, content and recommendations. A coseller is anyone who contributes in these ways. You don’t need to be a salesperson or close a sale yourself.

The opportunity is a stronger local economy, built by the people who participate in it. When eligible commerce launches, qualifying contributions can also become a side income.

Hey99 is preparing to launch. There is no active checkout or payout yet, and preview activity does not create rewards. Bring a business, an idea or a connection, and help shape what comes next.

title: A recipe can start a journey.
summary: Why sharing something useful can matter, even when you never mention the thing someone eventually buys.
body:
Imagine your mom shares a recipe she liked from the market on Nextdoor. Someone follows her recommendation. Later, that same person discovers a different article through Facebook and buys a travel package.

If both interactions qualify under that offer’s rules, your mom and the other contributor share the available commission. She never mentioned the trip, persuaded anyone or closed the sale. Her recommendation simply began part of the buyer’s journey.

We call those connected contributions the chain of influence. The platform connects qualifying steps in that same buyer’s journey and shares the reward automatically. Each offer explains the period in which interactions count and which contributions qualify.

That is the idea behind #coselling is #noselling. Share something useful with someone who might appreciate it. Your contribution can be the beginning of a discovery, rather than its final step.

Hey99 is a preview. Personal links can credit participation, but preview activity creates no earnings. The launch economics and offer-specific terms determine future rewards.

title: Connections that keep contributing.
summary: How recommendations, lasting referral relationships and reusable content can work together.
body:
You can participate actively by recommending a local offer or sharing a useful story. When your qualifying engagement is the only one in the influence window, you can receive the whole available coseller pool, adjusted for applicable passive referral and creator shares. When several people influence that buyer, the available pool is shared under the offer’s rules.

Seller-approved pools can reach up to 30% of the eligible transaction value, and sometimes more. Each offer states its actual rate and whether the percentage applies to the whole sale or a defined portion.

You can also establish an accepted, credited referral relationship once. A seller introduction gives you 5% of that seller’s eligible coseller pool as qualifying sales happen. A coseller introduction gives you 5% of that person’s eligible coseller earnings. These relationships do not expire and can generate passive income for as long as the platform exists, without repeating the introduction. Payments still depend on qualifying activity.

Useful content can keep working too. When another coseller uses your content in a qualifying sale, you receive 10% of that coseller’s earnings from the sale, allocated from their reward.

Your eligible contribution earns the share stated in the offer. Only a cancelled or reversed sale reduces the earnings tied to that sale. An open dispute may temporarily pause payment while it is resolved.

These are intended launch terms. Hey99’s preview does not create rewards, and checkout and payouts are not active. You can help shape the market now, at your own pace.
